description: Strategy-point memory snapshot with action-phase namespaces. Situation field is used for semantic search; action stores the recommended move.

value.action: In an information vacuum, instead of just calling for caution which can be seen as passive or self-interested, proactively structure the discussion. Propose a specific, actionable plan to generate information, such as systematically gathering reads from every player or analyzing early voting patterns. This frames you as a helpful, town-aligned leader rather than a passive survivor.

value.action: When multiple evil factions are active (e.g., Wolves + SK) and a single player (a vocal villager or yourself) is the obvious target for a coordinated attack, do not protect them, as your single heal will be overwhelmed. Instead, protect a secondary, less prominent player who you still have a solid town-read on. This forces evils to split their attack or guarantees the survival of another town asset, preventing the waste of your heal on an unsavable target.
